title: Quick Velvety Argentinian Yautia Gratin
description: A yeasty and velvety Argentinian dish featuring yautia, perfect for a quick and energizing meal, made with beurre-monte and egg-free-friendly ingredients, served in a ramekin.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the garlic and onion to the skillet and cook until softened, about 3 minutes.
Add the sliced yautia to the skillet and cook for an additional 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
In a small saucepan, melt the beurre-monte over low heat.
In a separate bowl, combine the cooked yautia, melted beurre-monte, salt, and black pepper.
Transfer the yautia mixture to a ramekin and top with the shredded gruyere cheese.
Bake the gratin in the preheated oven for 20 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove the gratin from the oven and sprinkle with chopped parsley.
Serve the Quick Velvety Argentinian Yautia Gratin hot, straight from the ramekin.
